description: This Java class 'SecurityConfig' configures Spring Security for a web application. It sets up JWT authentication, CORS policies, password encoding with BCrypt, and security filter chains to define endpoint access rules.

classes.name: SecurityConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for setting up security policies in the application, including JWT authentication, CORS, and authorization rules.

methods.name: passwordEncoder
methods.description: Defines a bean that provides password encoding using BCryptPasswordEncoder.

methods.name: authenticationManager
methods.description: Defines a bean for the AuthenticationManager, retrieving it from the AuthenticationConfiguration.

methods.name: filterChain
methods.description: Configures the HTTP security, adding JWT filter, CORS, CSRF disable, session policy, and request authorization rules.

methods.name: corsConfigurationSource
methods.description: Creates and configures CORS policies, including allowed origins, methods, headers, and credentials.
